description:
GOAL: A module that declares @type t :: opaque resource(T) can construct its t with make_resource and return it through a declared contract.

SIGNAL:
- return inference mints the owner’s opaque alias for exact resource payloads before contract refinement
- an external caller can pass the returned handle to the module’s t-typed operation
- non-owner field access remains rejected
- the three execution doors agree

STRATEGY:
- resolve the owner t alias’s validated resource inner alongside its nominal tag
- apply the existing Types::mint_owned_resource_aliases primitive at the function-return boundary
- keep the effect restricted to resources constructed/returned by the declaring module.
title: Brand opaque resource returns in their owner module
